captionConversion.practice: renshu/video/cue; A/B ja/second only; scene context and masked text omitted
captionConversion.challenge: challenge/video/cue ja/first, including official context/instructions/sample answers for all person values; masked text omitted. Not a verified speech transcript.
captionConversion.intervals: Source cue times, endSeconds=next cue; every empty/context cue is text:null, final blank cue retains endSeconds:null
captionConversion.terminalSentinel: Omit artificial blank999 marker only if the preceding source cue already clears text; otherwise retain999 as the only source-provided clear boundary. Final blank cue has endSeconds:null.
